confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on a few aggregator and venue-level data points, not a verified city-wide price survey. Cappuccino is from a single crowd-sourced estimate (range about $4-8). Cocktail and wine lean on Orlando venue menus and a national US benchmark. Beer is the least certain drink anchor: venue menus were $12.50-14, a crowd-sourced pub figure was about $7 (converted from EUR), and happy-hour prices were lower. The meal anchors draw on a budget-guide range, a fast-food combo price and an expat dinner-for-two estimate with wine removed. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season Orlando market. No accommodation prices were searched, and no live listings were checked. Tax and tip are excluded.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Pricing was anchored to US tourism-oriented metro markets, with theme-park-area price levels considered, and to the Orlando-specific data points above.
